page.layout: One printed page. Running head at the top centre. One main text column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Catchword "Et" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: per se colore destituuntur interiora corporis, sed is color potentia tantum aspectabilis est, & actu fit visibilis cum corpus diffecatur.
Color Realis est Simplex, qui & primus & extremus dicitur: vel Mixtus, ex duorum primorum commixtione ortus, qui & Medius dicitur.
Color Realis simplex.Simplex seu extremus, est primi & simplicis ortus, non ex aliorum commistione contemperatus. Estque Albedo & Nigredo, seu Albor & Nigror.
Albus.Albedo est color extremus seu simplex, multum habens luciditatis, visum disgregans.
Corpus itaq; Album plurimum habet luminositatis, eaq; si magna fuerit, visum dissipat[?] & offendit.
Niger.Nigredo est color extremus seu simplex, multum habens obscuritatis, parum luciditatis, visum contrahens.
Nigrum itaq; Corpus plurimum continet opacitatis, & obscuri, ideoque visum contrahit & congregat.
Color realis Mixtus.Mixtus seu Medius color est, ex permixtione extremorum conflatus: seu, ex simplicium contemperatione produ-ctus.

page.notes: Printed page number at top left is partly unclear; read as 52 (old form of the figure). Two words are doubtful: "diffecatur" and "difsipat" (read as dissipat), both marked. The marginal notes are in italic and are placed beside the paragraphs they stand against. The Greek-free text has no other damage.
